tools.name: nsm_session_sso
tools.description: GET SSO token from URL for user authentication. NSM will return Bearer Token after successful login. Step 3 of the documented MySonicWall-key to NSM-token exchange. Body fields: tenantserial, code, client. On success NSM returns the bearer token in status.info[0].message (FortiSOAR connector-sonicwall-nsm reads it there). Token lasts 8 hours with a 15-minute inactivity timeout (MySonicWall API guide, 'Generating NSM Token using MySonicWall API Key'). Prefer the `nsm-login` command, which runs all three steps.
